items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: And then when I left, went to Europe in 26 wide, Earl took my job with Jimmy Newman at the Apex. The Apex. Yeah. Earl took over. That was my job.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Jelly was best without songs. Tony was best with songs. And then this other boy came here, Harry Collins, came here around twenty. Around nineteen, now twenty. And he brought a young fella here from Pittsburgh. And he introduced, brought him to me because I was one of the best known of the fellas. And told me to look after him. And I said I would. So I carried him around and introduced him all over the other side. Who was that, Earl Hines?
